topic: Specification of hydraulic oil, need for clean pipelines and use of protective ointment while handling oils.
syllabus_extract: Specification of hydraulic oil, need for clean pipelines and use of protective ointment while handling oils.
specific_objectives: 23.1.2.1 Trainee will be able to describe typical hydraulic system and construction of its components.

practical: Demonstration of oil spill containment and application of protective ointment on skin; Safety: Wear gloves and eye protection; Supervision: Instructor monitors all trainee movements.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of hydraulic fluid in an aircraft system?
Why must hydraulic pipelines be free from contaminants before installation?
What immediate action is required if hydraulic oil contacts the skin?

summary_questions: Explain how oil viscosity changes with temperature and why this matters for system performance.
Describe the specific risks posed by water contamination in hydraulic lines.
Outline the correct steps for applying protective ointment before handling hydraulic oil.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note comparing the specifications of hydraulic oil used in LP 02 versus current systems, highlighting any differences in viscosity or additive requirements.
